page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is an entry-level GPU-accelerated cloud server instance within the ecs.gn5i instance family. Constructed on the x86_64 CPU architecture under KVM hypervisor management, this instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs paired with 8.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a allocation ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

Hardware acceleration is supplied via a single NVIDIA P4 graphics processing unit with 8 GB of total VRAM. Network provisioning offers a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. The instance contains no bundled local disk storage, requiring deployment alongside external cloud block storage services for operating system and application host requirements.

The hardware configuration offers a cost-effective pathway to discrete GPU compute without requiring high-density, multi-card deployments. Potential resource bottlenecks include modest single-node CPU capacity, baseline networking throughput, and the complete reliance on attached network storage for disk operations.

The Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large instance is best aligned with lightweight machine learning inference workloads, computer vision processing, media stream decoding, video transcoding pipelines, and small-scale acceleration tasks.
